# Standard library

**Audience:** Edva users and integrators<br>
**Status:** public module inventory; per-module references are in progress<br>
**Audited:** `8b8cb19`<br>
**Evidence:** `prelude.dva`, `std/`, `selfhost/src/edva.dva`

The prelude is loaded automatically unless `-no-prelude` is passed. It imports
`io` and provides global output helpers such as `print`, `print_int`, and
`print_float`, plus generic helpers including `apply`, `map`, `filter`, and
`find`. Import other modules explicitly with `#use`.

| Module | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `color` | color values and formatting helpers |
| `fmt` | formatting helpers |
| `in` | input utilities |
| `io` | readers, writers, and standard streams |
| `json` | JSON parsing and rendering |
| `libc` | C library bindings |
| `math` | math bindings and helpers; includes `math/complex` and `math/geom` |
| `mem` | memory utilities |
| `net` | network primitives; includes `net/http` |
| `os` | hosted operating-system operations |
| `sort` | sorting helpers |
| `str` | string conversion and manipulation |
| `sys` | process and system facilities |
| `type` | compile-time type predicates |
| `unicode` | Unicode and UTF-8 helpers |
| `uring` | io_uring bindings where supported |

`phase5_probe` and target-support files are implementation probes, not public
API. Platform requirements vary, especially for `libc`, `net`, `os`, and
`uring`; consult each module's source until its dedicated reference page is
published.

Detailed pages are available for the [prelude](prelude.qmd), [I/O](io.qmd),
[standard input](in.qmd), [strings](str.qmd), [Unicode](unicode.qmd),
[formatting](fmt.qmd), [sorting](sort.qmd), [compile-time type predicates](type.qmd),
[JSON](json.qmd), and [math](math.qmd).

```dva
#use str

print $ str::from_int(42)
```
